name: Spark Submit Resource
description: Register a SparkSubmitResource (run spark-submit as a reusable resource method) for use by other components -- the Airflow SparkSubmitOperator equivalent as an injectable resource.
author: Dagster Community

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Key used to register this resource. Other components reference it via resource_key.

spark_submit_binary.label: Spark Submit Binary
spark_submit_binary.description: Path to the spark-submit binary. Defaults to 'spark-submit' on PATH.
